item_summary: $300-400 27-inch 4K USB-C IPS monitor with 99% sRGB color accuracy and 65W integrated power delivery
detailed_item_draft: Shopping Brief: 27-inch 4K UHD (3840x2160) IPS Display. Budget Constraint: $300-$400 USD. Color Performance: 99% sRGB coverage with Delta E < 2 accuracy for professional design work. Power & Connectivity: USB-C input with 65W Power Delivery (PD) and DisplayPort Alt Mode to charge laptops while displaying. Ergonomics: Stand must offer height adjustment, tilt, swivel, and pivot (portrait) modes. Build Quality: Matte anti-glare panel, thin bezel design, VESA mount support (100x100mm). Port Selection: USB-C (65W PD), HDMI 2.0, DisplayPort 1.4, USB downstream hub. Ideal Usage: Photo editing, graphic design, and dual-laptop docking station replacement. Target Models: Dell UltraSharp U2723QE, LG 27UP850-N, ASUS ProArt PA278QV (if within budget).
